description: Variation of condition 02, 03 and 04 of application: 22/03720/FUL to allow internal layout for the increase of occupancy from five persons to six persons.
decision_conditions: (Revised) Completion of works- Time ConditionThe development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice under 22/03720/FUL dated 23.01.2023. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

(Revised) Approved Plans and DocumentsThe development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans and documents, as set out below:GR22-01; GR22-02; GR22-03 Rev A; GR26-04 Rev 2; GR22-05; Planning, Design and Access Statement dated 19.01.2023.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 3The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time acting as a single household and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the communal kitchen, living and dining room shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development shall not be carried out other than in complete accordance with the submitted details of refuse storage facilities. The approved facilities shall thereafter be provided in its entirety prior to the first occupation of the new dwelling, and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction target.This condition was discharged under 23/00819/CND on 09.05.2023.

The development shall not be carried out other than in complete accordance with the submitted details of long-stay secure and covered cycle storage and short-stay cycle storage. The approved facilities shall thereafter be provided in full prior to the first occupation of the new dwelling, and permanently retained thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision of cycle parking spaces in line with the Council's adopted standards.This condition was discharged under 23/00819/CND on 09.05.2023.
